svg.title: EKS multi-environment project roadmap
svg.desc: Three milestones: Terraform EKS cluster with MySQL, remote state, and Jenkins CI/CD pipeline

g.text: Goal: provision 3 identical environments (dev, test, staging) via code — not manual clicks
Milestone 1 — Terraform project: EKS cluster + MySQL

svg.text: Write the Terraform config once — run it 3 times to get dev, test, and staging.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What should go in my Terraform git repo structure for EKS?')
sendPrompt('Show me the AWS EBS CSI driver addon config for Terraform EKS module v20')
sendPrompt('Show me the EKS module config with 3 nodes and 1 Fargate profile for a Java app')
sendPrompt('Show me the helm_release Terraform resource for MySQL with 3 replicas and depends_on EKS')
sendPrompt('Show me the values.yaml for MySQL bitnamilegacy with persistent volumes')
sendPrompt('How do I run terraform apply 3 times for dev, test and staging with different variable files?')

svg.text: Use -var-file=dev.tfvars / test.tfvars / staging.tfvars to keep cluster names and tags distinct
depends_on = [module.eks.cluster_name] on the MySQL helm_release — prevents race condition
Local state breaks in a team — whoever runs apply last wins. Move it to S3 so everyone sees the same truth.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I create an S3 bucket for Terraform remote state with versioning enabled?')
sendPrompt('Show me the Terraform backend S3 block with DynamoDB state locking')
sendPrompt('What happens when I run terraform init after adding a remote S3 backend?')

svg.text: One S3 bucket per environment — use separate state keys: dev/terraform.tfstate, test/terraform.tfstate, staging/terraform.tfstate

g.text: Milestone 3 — Jenkins CI/CD pipeline for Terraform

svg.text: The platform team commits infra changes to git — the pipeline applies them. No more manual terraform runs.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I store AWS credentials in Jenkins for a Terraform pipeline?')
sendPrompt('Show me a complete Jenkinsfile for a Terraform project with init, plan, approve, and apply stages')
sendPrompt('What should the stages be in a Terraform Jenkins pipeline for EKS?')
sendPrompt('Show me the terraform init stage in a Jenkinsfile with S3 backend')
sendPrompt('How do I save terraform plan output to a file in Jenkins?')
sendPrompt('How do I add a manual approval gate in a Jenkins declarative pipeline?')
sendPrompt('Show me terraform apply using a saved plan file in a Jenkinsfile')

svg.text: Trigger on push to main of the Terraform repo — inject AWS creds via withCredentials block
Never use -auto-approve in the pipeline — always apply from the saved tfplan file

g.text: Outcome: dev, test, and staging are identical to production
Provisioned from the same Terraform code, applied 3 times — no manual work, no drift
